subject.title: [Feature]: Option to force-prepend an opening <think> tag for local reasoning models

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class default-off synthetic `<think>` opener option, or should missing reasoning delimiters remain provider/plugin-owned through params, catalog metadata, and stream wrappers?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds a new config/output-format contract in an area where repository policy requires proof that existing provider/plugin behavior cannot solve it.

options.title: Prefer provider-owned controls first
options.body: Use provider params, model compatibility metadata, or provider stream wrappers unless maintainers confirm they cannot cover the observed models.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core option
options.body: Add a documented default-off config path, wire it through runner/subscriber params, and prove streaming plus final-message behavior for native-tag and no-tag outputs.

options.title: Reject delimiter synthesis
options.body: Close the direction as not planned and ask users to rely on provider/model request settings or prompt templates instead.

recommendation.title: Prefer provider-owned controls first
recommendation.body: Use provider params, model compatibility metadata, or provider stream wrappers unless maintainers confirm they cannot cover the observed models.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest routing signal from official maintainer status, the existing durable review, and recent adjacent reasoning/runtime work.
